title: Cozy rainy desk
prompt: Soft lighting, warm colors, medium close-up shot. Rain runs down a window beside a wooden desk with an open notebook, a steaming mug of coffee and a small lamp glowing. A hand turns a page slowly while a candle flickers. Static camera, cozy aesthetic vertical video.

title: Outfit spin transition
prompt: Daylight, medium shot, center composition. A young woman in a flowing yellow summer dress spins around once in a sunny city street, her dress and hair swirling, then stops and smiles at the camera. Shop windows and passing people behind her. Static camera, fashion reel, vertical video.

title: Golden hour hair flip
prompt: Sunset time, backlight, warm colors, medium close-up shot. A young woman in a field of tall grass flips her long hair in slow motion, the low sun shining through the strands, then looks into the camera and smiles. Slow motion, vertical lifestyle reel.

title: Satisfying honey pour
prompt: Studio lighting, extreme close-up shot, warm colors. Thick golden honey pours slowly from a wooden dipper onto a stack of pancakes, folding over itself and spreading across the top. Shallow depth of field, slow motion, satisfying food clip.

title: Kinetic sand cutting
prompt: Soft studio lighting, close-up shot. A knife slowly slices through a smooth block of pastel pink and blue kinetic sand, the cut pieces crumbling and falling softly onto a white table. Static top camera, satisfying ASMR clip, vertical video.

title: City night walk POV
prompt: Night time, practical lighting, mixed colors. First-person view walking through a busy city street at night, neon signs glowing, people passing, car lights streaking by and light rain on the pavement reflecting the colors. Handheld walking camera, vertical vlog.

title: Gym motivation
prompt: Hard lighting, side lighting, low angle shot. A muscular man lifts a heavy barbell in a dark gym, chalk dust floating in a beam of light, sweat on his forehead. He lowers the bar and breathes out. Slow motion, cinematic fitness reel, vertical video.

title: Floating headphones
prompt: Studio lighting, edge lighting, center composition. A pair of matte black wireless headphones floats and rotates slowly in the air against a deep blue gradient background, soft light sweeping across the ear cups. Clean premium product commercial, no text.

title: Burger commercial
prompt: Warm studio lighting, close-up shot. A juicy cheeseburger is assembled in slow motion: a beef patty drops onto the bun, melted cheese drips down its side, lettuce and tomato land on top and sesame seeds bounce. Dark background, food commercial.

title: Luxury car reveal
prompt: Night time, edge lighting, low angle shot, cool colors. A silver luxury sports car sits in a dark studio as a strip of light moves slowly along its body, revealing its curves and wheels. Light smoke drifts across the floor. Slow camera slide along the car, premium car commercial.

title: Real estate living room
prompt: Bright daylight, wide shot, warm colors. A modern living room with a large window, a grey sofa, wooden floor and green plants, sunlight falling across the room. Smooth gimbal shot moving slowly forward toward the window, real estate video.

title: Fashion runway
prompt: Hard lighting, low angle shot, center composition. A model in an elegant black coat walks confidently toward the camera on a white runway, photographers' flashes going off on both sides. Slow motion, fashion show, vertical video.

title: Soda can splash
prompt: Studio lighting, close-up shot, cool colors. A cold red soda can with water droplets spins slowly while ice cubes and splashes of soda burst around it against a bright gradient background. Slow motion, drink commercial, vertical video, no text.

title: Anime rooftop wind
prompt: Anime style, sunset time, warm colors, medium shot. An anime girl with short blue hair stands on a school rooftop, her uniform and hair blowing in the wind as cherry blossom petals fly past. She looks out over the city and smiles. Japanese animation style, soft colors.

title: Corgi astronaut
prompt: 3D animated style, medium shot. A cute corgi in a small white astronaut suit floats inside a spaceship, paws paddling, with Earth visible through the round window behind it. Its ears flop as it turns toward the camera. Bright, playful animated film look.

title: Tiny chef mouse
prompt: 3D animated style, warm colors, close-up shot. A tiny grey mouse in a chef's hat stirs a little pot of soup on a kitchen counter, steam rising, then tastes it with a spoon and smiles. Pixar-like animation, cozy kitchen lighting.

title: Claymation toy city
prompt: Claymation style, bright daylight, high angle shot. A tiny colourful clay city with little cars driving along the streets, clay people walking and a train moving over a bridge. Stop-motion animation look, playful.

title: Whale in the clouds
prompt: Sunset time, wide shot, warm colors. A giant blue whale swims slowly through golden clouds in the sky, its tail moving up and down, small birds flying beside it. The camera tracks alongside the whale, dreamlike fantasy film.

title: Cat DJ party
prompt: Night time, colorful neon lighting, medium shot. A cool cat wearing sunglasses and headphones scratches records on a DJ table, nodding its head to the beat while colored party lights flash behind it. Fun vertical video.

title: Origami birds take off
prompt: Soft daylight, close-up shot. Folded paper origami birds on a wooden desk come to life, flap their paper wings and fly up out of an open window into a blue sky. Magical realism, shallow depth of field.
